Button.OnMouseEnter:
local text = [[ Whenever you earn AP in a tickable area ( like a keep ), it will be recorded here for reference so you can keep track of which defensive tick lists you are on.
Earning AP in an identical category area will remove you from your current list of that category and place you in the new one.
Example: If you earn AP in range of Castle Alessia, you are on the Keep tick list, for Castle Alessia.
If you earn AP at another Keep before Alessia's defence tick goes off, you will not recieve it, as you will be on this new Keeps defence tick list.]] ZO_Tooltips_ShowTextTooltip(self, TOPRIGHT, text)
